requirements.statement: Administrators can sign in securely before changing what is monitored

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor cannot reach the repository, chat, or connection configuration
A signed-in Administrator reaches the configuration screens

requirements.statement: An Administrator can add a GitHub repository to the watch list

criteria.must: Adding a repository puts it on the watch list
Adding a repository already on the watch list is rejected

requirements.statement: An Administrator can remove a repository from the watch list

criteria.must: Removing a watched repository takes it off the watch list
Removed repositories no longer generate notifications

requirements.statement: An Administrator can view the current list of watched repositories

criteria.must: The watch list screen shows every currently watched repository

requirements.statement: An Administrator can configure the destination Google Chat space

criteria.must: Setting the Chat destination saves the space name and webhook
An invalid webhook value is rejected

requirements.statement: An Administrator can see a log of recent notifications sent

criteria.must: The notification log lists notifications the system has sent, most recent first

requirements.statement: Each Google Chat notification for a critical issue shows the issue's title, repository, and a link to GitHub

criteria.must: The notification message includes the issue title
The notification message includes the repository name
The notification message includes a link back to the GitHub issue

requirements.statement: The system never sends more than one notification for the same critical issue

criteria.must: A critical issue that has already triggered a notification does not trigger a second one on a later check

requirements.statement: An Administrator connects GitHub through a sign-in-with-GitHub OAuth flow instead of pasting a token

criteria.must: Connecting GitHub completes through an OAuth authorization step, with no field for pasting a token
A successful authorization records the GitHub connection as active
